dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Buccaneers (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Panthers
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Tampa Bay signed CB Brandon Johnson to the practice squad [Greg Auman](https://x.com/gregauman/status/2125618175509209491).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Todd Bowles and the medical staff evaluate DT Elijah Simmons (concussion), S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle), CB Benjamin Morrison (hamstring), and CB Jacob Parrish (back) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [buccaneers.com Official](https://www.buccaneers.com/news/rookie-te-bauer-sharp-making-impact-as-a-blocker-updates) [Brianna Dix](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4912847/jacob-parrish#:~:text=Buccaneers%20head%20coach%20Todd%20Bowles%20said%20that). CB Josh Hayes (knee (surgery)) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [Greg Auman](https://x.com/gregauman/status/2125618175509209491).

Week 12 Panthers Outlook: Todd Bowles and DC Todd Bowles open installation for the Carolina Panthers (5-5, TB -3, HC/DC Todd Bowles vs. HC Dave Canales, OC Brad Idzik & DC Todd Wash (Raymond James Stadium))—a unit ranked #5 in Def. Takeaways / Game (1.60) as Tampa Bay prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [buccaneers.com Official](https://www.buccaneers.com/news/panthers-buccaneers-top-storylines-key-matchups-in-week-12) [Gil Arcia](https://www.bucsnation.com/tampa-bay-buccaneers-odds/69895/buccaneers-vs-panthers-odds-week-12-opening-lines-point-spread-total).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (2nd in NFC South • #12 Seed in NFC), Tampa Bay carries a 31.2% postseason projection, 31% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Jeremy Brener](https://www.bucsnation.com/tampa-bay-buccaneers-news/69947/tampa-bay-buccaneers-news-bucs-loss-vs-lions-could-have-major-repercussions).
